Access_Policy: Not allowed by IT: the key is not sent to this server
Cleanup_Intro: These rules run after every dictation, with or without AI.
Company_CodeInvalid: The company code has 16 characters, e.g. ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS.
Company_ConnectDesc: For companies with their own WhisperLoom server: your IT team gives you the server address and company code.
Company_ConnectFooter: Without a company you manage everything yourself. Your own shortcuts stay yours even with a company.
Company_Err_client_outdated: WhisperLoom is too old for this server. Please update.
Company_Err_code_invalid: Company code unknown or expired. Please ask your IT team.
Company_Err_config_invalid: The company configuration could not be applied. Please tell your IT team.
Company_Err_device_blocked: Your IT team has blocked this device.
Company_Err_device_pending: This device is still waiting for approval by your IT team.
Company_Err_device_unknown: This device is no longer known to the company server. Please connect again.
Company_Err_internal_error: The company server reported an error. Please try again later.
Company_Err_invalid_request: Invalid request. Please check the server address and company code.
Company_Err_leave_not_allowed: Your company does not allow you to disconnect yourself.
Company_Err_not_found: The server does not offer this feature. Is the address correct?
Company_Err_offline: Company server unreachable. Check the network and address; the last configuration stays in effect.
Company_Err_other: The company server rejected the request.
Company_Err_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
Company_Err_service_unavailable: The company server is under maintenance. Please try again later.
Company_Err_tenant_blocked: The company is blocked on the server.
Company_Err_too_many_pending: Too many devices are waiting for approval. Please try again later.
Company_LeaveConfirm: Really leave? Company access and the proxy stop working; your other settings stay.
Company_LeaveDesc: Disconnects this device. The company values stay as your own settings.
Company_LeaveLocked: Your company has decided that this connection stays in place.
Company_Notice_blocked: {0} has blocked this device. Company access is off; your own settings are unchanged.
Company_Notice_revoked: {0} has removed this device. Company access is off; connect again if needed.
Company_ServerHttps: Please use https:// (http:// only within your own network).
Company_ServerInvalid: Not a valid address. Example: https://wl.example.com
Company_StatusDesc: Approval by your IT team on the company server
Company_SyncNowDesc: Fetches settings and access right away; otherwise every 15 minutes
Company_Waiting: Waiting for approval by your IT team
Company_WaitingDetail: {0} needs to approve this device in the portal (device ID {1}). It continues on its own afterwards.
Error_Budget: Company budget for this month reached – please ask your IT team
Error_NotConfigured: Recognition not set up — check provider and key in the settings
Error_WithRetry: {0} – Send again from the tray menu
G_CustomProviders_Footer: For servers with a key or outside this PC. Without a key on this PC or in the LAN: “Local models” → “Local servers”. http:// only to addresses in your own network.
G_LocalServers_Footer: Without a key, on this PC or in the LAN: OpenAI-compatible, e.g. LM Studio, llama.cpp, faster-whisper-server or Ollama (address ending in /v1). Servers with a key: page “Providers”.
G_Local_Footer: Applies when recognition is set to “Local”. Works offline.
G_Online_Footer: Applies when recognition is set to “Online”.
G_TextModels_Footer: Runs via llama.cpp on this device. Free licence (Apache-2.0), downloaded from Hugging Face, verified by SHA-256.
G_WhisperModels_Footer: Whisper downloads are the default. Own ggml/gguf files are not copied; choose them on the page “Recognition”.
History_ClearConfirm: Delete all dictations? This cannot be undone.
History_OffConfirm_Desc: Turning it off deletes all saved dictations. This cannot be undone.
History_ReplaceEdited: This version was edited. Replace it with a new run?
History_ReprocessHint: From the raw text with the chosen stage, no audio; result goes to the clipboard
History_ReprocessTip: Run the original through another stage – as a new version, in the background
History_Status_done: Processed again – result is on the clipboard
History_Status_insertFailed: Insert failed – press Ctrl+C and paste yourself
History_Status_kept: The version was edited meanwhile – the edit stays
Hotkey_Conflict_AltGr: Ctrl+Alt is AltGr: blocks special characters
Hotkey_Conflict_Autocomplete: Used by VS Code and IntelliJ (autocomplete)
Hotkey_Conflict_InputLanguage: Windows uses it to switch the input language
Hotkey_Conflict_NoModifier: Without Ctrl/Alt/Win the key is captured everywhere
Hotkey_Conflict_Overlay: Collides with the overlay keys (Enter, Backspace)
Hotkey_Conflict_SingleModifier: A single modifier interferes with normal typing
Hotkey_Conflict_Windows: Win combinations are often taken by Windows
Insert_InputRejected: Input rejected – text is on the clipboard
Insert_NoTextField: No text field – text is on the clipboard
Insert_NotForeground: Target window not reachable – text is on the clipboard
Insert_TargetGone: Target window is gone – text is on the clipboard
Insert_TargetProtected: Admin window does not accept input – text is on the clipboard
Key_AtCompany: Runs through your company: this device signs in to the company server itself, no key of your own is needed.
Key_AtEntry: The key belongs to the provider (page “Providers”) and is only sent to its address.
Local_BundledHint: Download the model on the page “Local models”. It starts on demand, already while you record.
Local_ModelsMoved: Download models and add your own Whisper files on the page “Local models”.
Local_OllamaEmpty: Ollama is running but has no model installed (e.g. “ollama pull qwen3:4b”).
Local_OllamaMissing: Ollama not found (127.0.0.1:11434). Install and start it, then reload:
Local_SelectedFileMissing: File not found or not a model. Check it on the page “Local models” or choose another model.
Local_ServerHint: Add servers on the page “Local models”.
Models_Http: Server responded with HTTP {0}. Check address and key.
Models_NoAccess: “Same as recognition” has no access with local recognition.
Models_NoList: The server returned no model list.
Output_Hint_RawOnly: Inserted without AI – text improvement not reachable
Output_LinuxHint: On Linux the result of every dictation is on the clipboard. Paste with Ctrl+V.
Overlay_KeysHint: Enter insert · Backspace discard · click the stage to change it
Overlay_SkipHint: Press the shortcut again = insert now without AI
Overlay_StageTip: Choose the stage for this dictation
Policy_Hint: Greyed-out fields are set by IT.
Profile_Hint: If the target window matches a profile, its stage, output and Enter apply. A profile with a window title wins; otherwise the first match. The stage hotkey changes the stage of the active profile.
Profile_InvalidTitle: Invalid regex – the profile never matches
Provider_InUse: In use by: {0}. Choose another provider there first.
Provider_KeyNewHost: The stored key will now be sent to {0}. Keep it only if you trust this server; otherwise delete the key.
Provider_Key_Desc: Belongs to this provider and is only sent to its address.
Provider_Models_Desc: Model IDs, comma-separated. Empty = load the list from the server.
Provider_Protocol_Desc: OpenAI-compatible: recognition and text. Ollama, Anthropic: text. ElevenLabs: recognition.
Providers_DeleteConfirm: Delete this provider and its key?
Providers_Empty: No custom provider yet. Add your own servers (LM Studio, vLLM, LiteLLM …) or extra accounts here; they then appear for recognition and text.
Recording_Capped: 12 minutes reached – recording paused, please send
Recording_Long: 2 minutes left – recording pauses at 12 minutes
Rewrite_NoInstruction: No instruction recognised – selection left unchanged
Rewrite_RestoreFailed: Clipboard could not be restored – it now holds the selection
Server_ModelFirst: empty = first model of the server
Server_NameInvalid: Name missing, contains “:” or is already used. Not saved.
Set_Accurate_Desc: Beam search: more accurate, but slower
Set_AlwaysCopy: Always copy to the clipboard too
Set_AlwaysCopy_Desc: After inserting, the text is also on the clipboard. Without a text field it always goes there.
Set_ApiKey_Desc: Stored in the system keychain, never in the settings file
Set_CustomModels_Desc: ggml or gguf file, e.g. a fine-tuned model.
Set_CustomProviders_Desc: Selectable for every access: recognition, text and fallback.
Set_DisabledFillers_Desc: Built-in filler words to keep, separated by commas
Set_Engine_Desc: Online: provider with API key. Local: whisper.cpp on this PC.
Set_FallbackEnabled_Desc: Steps in when the first provider fails
Set_FillerList_Desc: In addition to the built-in list, separated by commas
Set_HistoryEnabled_Desc: Text only, no audio. Turning it off deletes the history.
Set_InsertMode_Desc: Where the dictation goes after the hold or toggle shortcut
Set_KeyStore_Desc: Where API keys are stored on this PC
Set_LlmProvider_Desc: “Same as recognition” uses the recognition provider and key
Set_LocalServers_Desc: Then selectable as a provider, also in the fallback chain.
Set_PressEnter_Desc: For example to send in a chat. App profiles can switch it on or off individually.
Set_RemoveFillers_Desc: uh, um … – fixed list per language
Set_StageFontSize_Desc: 16–96; also Ctrl+Plus/Minus in the stage view
Set_StageModel_Desc: Own model for this stage only
Set_Stage_Desc: What happens to the text after recognition; also in the tray
Set_VocabularyFile_Desc: .md or .txt, optional; read on every dictation
Settings_FallbackEnabled: Use the fallback provider when the first one fails
Settings_HistoryClearError: Saved, but the history could not be deleted
Settings_HistoryEnabled: Keep history (text only; turning it off deletes it)
Settings_KeyFileHint: No keyring (Secret Service) found: keys are stored in secrets.json in the data folder, readable only by you (mode 600).
Settings_PrivacyNote: Audio is never stored. Logs contain only duration, provider, status and error class.
Settings_StageModels: Model per stage (empty = model of the access)
Settings_VocabularyHint: Names and technical terms, one per line
Setup_AutostartError: The autostart entry could not be changed.
Setup_AutostartIntro: Start WhisperLoom automatically in the background when you sign in? Only for your user account, no admin rights.
Setup_AutostartUnavailable: Autostart is not supported on this system.
Setup_CompanyIntro: Enter the server address and company code from your IT team. Your IT team then approves this device.
Setup_CompanyLinkHint: Tip: if you have an invitation link (whisperloom://join…), click it or paste it into the address field.
Setup_CompanyWaitingNote: You can keep this window open or move on: “Skip” ends the setup and the app syncs in the background.
Setup_DoneAgain: You can run the setup again any time from the tray menu or with “WhisperLoom setup”.
Setup_DoneLinux: All set. Start dictating with your shortcut or {0}; the result is then on the clipboard.
Setup_DoneWindows: All set. Hold {0} to dictate or press {1} for the overlay. The text goes into the active window.
Setup_HotkeyIntro: Dictate with shortcuts: Hold = record while pressed. Toggle = open the overlay, a second press sends. Press one of the combos to test it.
Setup_HotkeyNone: No combo detected. Please try again.
Setup_HotkeyOther: Detected: {0} – that is none of your combos. Change them under Settings → Shortcuts.
Setup_HotkeyUnavailable: Shortcuts are not running right now (e.g. test mode). You can assign them under Settings → Shortcuts.
Setup_LanguageIntro: Which language should WhisperLoom use, and which language do you dictate in?
Setup_LinuxGnome: GNOME: Settings → Keyboard → View and Customize Shortcuts → Custom Shortcuts → +.
Setup_LinuxIntro: On Linux (Wayland in particular) apps get no global shortcuts. Bind a shortcut in your desktop environment to this command:
Setup_LinuxKde: KDE: System Settings → Keyboard → Shortcuts → Add New → Command or Script.
Setup_MicError: The microphone cannot be opened. Pick another device or check the connection.
Setup_MicIntro: Pick your microphone and say a few words. The bar only shows the level; nothing is stored or sent.
Setup_MicUnavailable: No usable microphone. Check the connection or the audio library; you can pick the microphone later in the settings.
Setup_PolicyHint: Your IT has already set some steps; they are skipped.
Setup_RecognitionIntro: Cloud: fast and accurate, needs an API key from your provider. Local: runs on this PC without internet, needs a model (one-time download).
Setup_StageIntro: What should happen to the text after recognition? You can switch the stage any time from the tray.
Setup_StageNote: Stages that improve the text use the recognition provider, or Ollama when local.
Setup_UsageCompanyDesc: Your IT team manages providers, models and access. You need the server address and a company code.
Setup_UsageIntro: WhisperLoom works on its own or managed centrally by your company. You can change this later under Settings → Company.
Setup_UsagePersonalDesc: You choose providers, models and keys yourself.
Sync_DictationTarget: Warning: dictations will also go to {0} (recognition or text refinement). Only apply if you trust that server.
Sync_EnterDisabled: Profile "{0}": "Enter afterwards" is turned off (foreign file). Turn it on in the profile itself if needed.
Sync_ExportDesc: Save to a file, e.g. for the Android app. Without keys.
Sync_Hint: Share settings as a file, e.g. with the Android app. Keys are never exported.
Sync_ImportDesc: Choose a file; you see every change before applying.
Sync_KeyDropRemoved: The key of "{0}" is deleted (entry removed).
Sync_KeyDropWarning: Warning: the file would send the key "{0}" to {1}. It is deleted when applying. Only enter it again if you trust {1}.
Sync_SecretsIgnored: Keys and policy in the file are ignored (only via "WhisperLoom provision").
Update_Available: WhisperLoom {0} is available. Install now and restart?
Validation_CustomEmpty: Please enter a name – otherwise the previous value stays.
Validation_Https: This provider needs an https:// address. Not saved.
Validation_Policy: Not approved by your IT department. Not saved.
Validation_Range: Please enter a number from {0} to {1}. Not saved.
Validation_RangeOrZero: Please enter 0 or a number from {0} to {1}. Not saved.
Validation_Url: Leave empty or enter an http:// or https:// address. Not saved.
